name: AIトリアージ機能を有効化する説明付きスイッチ行
prompt:
Second attempt. Recreate only the supplied Linear settings row, localized to Japanese, at exactly 816x88 px (9.27:1). Keep the card shallow, centered, and fully inside the canvas, with a small white breathing margin above and below: at final size the card should be about 810x80 px, starting near x=7,y=4. Do not let its outline touch or clip at the canvas edges.

Use exactly two single-line text rows at the left, beginning around x=27: title 「トリアージインテリジェンスを有効にする」 in regular/medium 16 px type, not bold; supporting text 「関連課題、チーム、担当者、プロジェクト、ラベルの提案を受け取ります」 in regular 14 px gray type. Keep the same modest gap between the two lines as the reference. Use a Japanese system sans face and restrained weight; the title should be dark charcoal and the support line a softer readable gray.

Place one off-state toggle near x=752, centered vertically, about 39x25 px. The track is pale neutral gray with a white circular knob on the left. Use the same thin pale-gray rounded outline and corner radius as the source card. Keep the large empty space between the text and toggle. Do not add an icon, extra words, heading, navigation, rows, shadows, gradients, or decorations. The only visible content is this one card and its off switch. Preserve the source proportions and the complete card border.
reviewNotes: Reviewed against the exact 816x88 source crop. The card is fully framed, with heading and supporting copy on two complete lines and the off-state toggle visible at the right. Side-by-side geometry is close: the bordered panel, copy inset, toggle placement, and short height match. Raw 1932x814 generation was framed to 1920x207 (aspect ratio within 0.03% of source) and proportionally resized to 816x88. The Japanese title is slightly heavier than the English source label; all text remains clear and unclipped.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
